text_block_list.text: (Ruuuumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (—The sounds. The vibrations.)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (The voices. The heat.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (Everything is reaching me—loud and clear.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(The feelings dwelling in my chest scream out as well:
"Win. Win. Win. Win"—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—What sleeps in this blood is pride.
What rightfully resides within is...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The "strongest"—!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Wh-What unbelievable...
What unbelievable strength...!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Duramente!
Mowing down all rivals in her way!
Displaying breathtaking dominance—”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Duramenteee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is that strength...? She's way stronger than she was back in the Classic Class...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...If it's her—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: If it's her...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-What is she...
Just how strong is that girl going to get...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Kitasan,
you already knew and felt it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Here's to Duramente-san's
complete recovery.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But...
she's grown even stronger than she was back during the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She's so incredible...
I definitely want to surpass her...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit!
We're growing day by day too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"How can one defeat a monster
that continues to grow stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —I keep turning thoughts over in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Long Black-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san...
I'm going to leave you speechless next time!
Duramente-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wait!
I wanna go too~"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is
looking forward...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...I... I just can't—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaarrrrgghhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I got ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Standing at the same starting line...
that was really all it was, and yet."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――...There's no way I can win...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Hit me with everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take on everything you've got.
—Because I am the 'strongest.'"
Having finished her race, Duramente had a somewhat satisfied expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“...Japanese races, too,
deserve to be aimed for by the rest of the world.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If I told you that's how I felt...
would you laugh?"
In fact, there have been past cases where Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume went on to compete in the Japan Cup.
choice_data_list: That momentum is already in motion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...It's thanks to the efforts of everyone
who has been involved in the races up until now."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it... I want to become an Umamusume
worthy of representing this nation."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And,
I will win... the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The next race... If I am to represent this country,
I wish to shoulder its tradition and history."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
I want this title."
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), a GⅠ race boasting long-standing tradition and history... For our next goal, we decided to pursue prestige befitting the strongest.
